#whatif #space #shorts

lines.text: What if the Moon just vanished tonight?
First, nights would get way darker. No more moonlight. Ever.
Ocean tides would shrink to about a third of their size, because only the Sun would be pulling on the water.
Animals that hunt, migrate or breed by moonlight would be thrown into chaos. Some corals only spawn after a full moon.
And over millions of years, Earth's tilt could wobble much more, bringing wild swings in climate.
The good news? The Moon isn't going anywhere. It only drifts away about four centimetres a year.
